most_similar_reason: Candidate 8 matches the target almost episode for episode: a god secretly warns a chosen man of a divinely decreed flood, he builds a great boat and loads it with living creatures, the deluge destroys all humanity, the boat grounds on a mountain, birds (including a raven that does not return) are released to test the waters, and he offers a sacrifice around which the gods gather and grant a blessing.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 9 shares nothing with the target beyond generic conflict and death \u2014 it is a dynastic war tale of a giant king, a marriage alliance, a resurrection cauldron, and a talking severed head, with no creator god, no flood, no ark, and no covenant.
pair: Genesis flood narrative | Gilgamesh flood myth
